questions.stem: The THREE kinds of Emergency under the Indian Constitution are:
questions.explanation: Art 352 — National Emergency (war / external aggression / armed rebellion). Art 356 — State Emergency / President's Rule (failure of constitutional machinery in a state). Art 360 — Financial Emergency (never used so far, but provisions exist). National, State (President's Rule), Financial.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.stem: National Emergency has been proclaimed in India HOW MANY times?
questions.explanation: 3 times under Art 352: (1) 1962 Sino-Indian war; (2) 1971 Bangladesh / Indo-Pak war; (3) 1975-77 internal disturbance (the Emergency imposed by Indira Gandhi). The 44th Amendment (1978) replaced 'internal disturbance' with 'armed rebellion' for tighter conditions.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.stem: A proclamation of Emergency (under Art 352) must be APPROVED by both Houses of Parliament WITHIN:
questions.explanation: Art 352 — proclamation must be approved within 1 MONTH by both Houses with SPECIAL MAJORITY. Once approved, it remains in force for 6 months; can be renewed indefinitely by further 6-monthly resolutions. 44th Amendment tightened this from the original lax safeguards.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.stem: Under Art 356, the proclamation of PRESIDENT'S RULE must be approved by Parliament WITHIN:
questions.explanation: Art 356 proclamation — 2 months for parliamentary approval (by simple majority). Once approved, stays for 6 months; can be extended by further 6-monthly resolutions up to 3 years (with special conditions for extension beyond 1 year). SR Bommai (1994) made this judicially reviewable.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.stem: During a NATIONAL EMERGENCY under Art 352, which Fundamental Rights REMAIN PROTECTED (cannot be suspended even via Art 359)?

options.option_text: Articles 20 and 21 (protection against arbitrary conviction + right to life/personal liberty)

questions.explanation: 44th Amendment (1978) — Arts 20 & 21 CANNOT be suspended even during National Emergency. Art 19 is suspended AUTOMATICALLY when the Emergency is due to WAR or EXTERNAL AGGRESSION. Other FRs can be suspended by a separate Art 359 order.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.stem: FINANCIAL EMERGENCY (Art 360) has been declared in India:
questions.explanation: Article 360 — never invoked. Even in the 1991 BoP crisis (near-default), formal Financial Emergency was NOT declared. Provisions: all money bills from state legislatures reserved for President; reduction of salaries (including of SC/HC judges); President can issue directions to states.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.stem: The EMERGENCY imposed in 1975-77 was on the grounds of:
questions.explanation: PM Indira Gandhi advised President Fakhruddin Ali Ahmed to declare Emergency on 'internal disturbance' grounds on 25 June 1975. Triggered by Allahabad HC ruling against her election. Ended 21 March 1977 after Congress lost the elections. 44th Amendment (1978) narrowed the ground to 'armed rebellion'. now amended to 'armed rebellion'.
